audit.scope: 20 of 27 varieties re-checked: all UK entries against the AHDB RL 2026/27 comments and SRUC tables; Fundulea varieties against Fundulea sheets and papers; Bavarian and Bioland entries against their lists; Plasmadur against topagrar. 7 have no source and stay unverified.

Added audit block, definitions and per-variety evidence.

All agronomy numbers are type defaults.

definitions.days_to_maturity_typical: Sowing-to-maturity in days for a sowing at the middle of sowing.window. Actual days shorten with later sowing, so the harvest window is not simply window_start + days.
definitions.gdd_basis: heat_units_to_reach and phases are cumulative growing degree-days from sowing, base = growth.heat_base_c. Type-level values unless a field is listed in verification.verified_fields.
definitions.maturity_group: Ordinal label used inside this file only. For maize it is derived from fao_number (<=200 very_early, 201-300 early, 301-370 medium, >370 late). For other crops it is a relative breeder/list rating where verified, else 'medium' default. It is not the national label of any source (Fundulea calls FAO 360-390 'semi-early'; LfL Bavaria calls K200 'frueh' and K230 'mittelfrueh').
